rationale: Y directly and forcefully covers the PR's central, most-repeated ground-truth thread (scope: validated only on Qwen-Image/H200 but flipped as default for ~14 other CUDA diffusion models), even naming the exact _DIFFUSION_IR_OP_PRIORITY_FUNCS/registry.py scoping mechanism hsliuustc0106 asked for — X only touches this obliquely via Cosmos3 and treats the PR's own scope claim as 'verified' rather than demanding more evidence. X compensates with a sharp hit on the pixelwise-parity-alongside-latency ask that Y misses, plus more literal ready-to-apply diff suggestions, giving it an edge in actionability and slightly tighter grounding. Both independently converge on several non-GT but clearly valid findings (nn.RMSNorm bypassing the platform's RMSNorm priority entirely, stale ROCm/XPU platforms, #4074/#3588 history), which cross-validates precision for both; Y carries slightly more unverifiable risk (three 'red' CI gates, a bare #4709 citation).
